changes: Auto Review: a Codex fallback account can take the default route (codex-auto-review, as the first account does) with no model to pick; other providers still name a model, and no fallback repeats an earlier route
Smart routing (0.7.0): within a Codex priority tier and across a managed account pool, the account with the most quota at risk per hour before its soonest reset is used first
CPA loads only Provider Manager: CPA Helper, CPA Auto Review, Cline Pass, CommandCode Go, CommandCode and Grok are its parts
Cline Pass, CommandCode Go, CommandCode and Grok accounts are provider-manager auth files with a kind; their models, logins and management routes are unchanged
